bad_columns: columns must be a list of column names
bad_item: Each result must be an object like {config, metric, value}
bad_mapping: mapping must be an object like {config: {col: …}, metric: …, value: …}
json_shape: No list of records found in the JSON: expected an array of objects, or an object of name → metrics
need_config: Choose the column that holds the config (or a fixed value)
need_metric: Choose which columns hold the metric and the value, or tick the columns that are metrics themselves
no_path: Give the path of a file
no_roots: No code folder is configured: add your experiment code folder to paths.tracker or paths.extra_read_dirs in studio.toml to list its CSV / JSON files here, or type a file path.
no_rows: No result rows could be read: check which columns hold the config, metric and value
node_none: No experiment or result node “{key}”. There are: {nodes}
path_big: The file is too big (at most {mb} MB)
path_denied: Files in this location cannot be read: {path}
path_relative: Give the full path (starting with / or ~/): {path}
table_empty: The table has no data: the first row should be the column names, then the data rows
unknown_fields: A result has no such fields: {fields}
